title: Resize the authored opponent range and rank hands by three-way equity when scaling observed opponents
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.29 (decision: Q-1 B resize the authored default range, Q-2 B hand order by equity against three random hands). Today estimateOpponentRanges replaces an observed opponent's range with the strongest width % of the hand order (TASK-7.13 A-8), so at the default width the 6-max BB call-raise range swaps 22, 54s-98s for AA, KK, QQ, JJ, AKs, AQs, AKo, AQo. The order (equity against one random hand) ranks K2o #87, Q2o #108 and J2o #123 above 87s #99, 76s #116 and 65s #128. Build the observed range by resizing the authored default with TASK-7.29 rule A-5, and regenerate src/advice/ranges/hand-order.json (format v1, same path) by seeded computeEquity against three random hands. Facts and locked-test map: doit/TASK-7.29/spec.md §3. Locked re-pin: tests/advice/observed-ranges.acceptance.test.ts AC#2 (owner TASK-7.13) asserts the prefix rule and must be unlocked and re-pinned under its owner to the resize rule; AC#5 and AC#6 and tests/advice/observed-range-tidy.acceptance.test.ts AC#1 (TASK-7.30) must pass unchanged. Re-verify the 4 observed golden postflop spots (tests/golden/postflop-spots.json lines 277, 799, 828, 1181). Any full 169-class recomputation check goes only in the opt-in npm run test:slow group.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given an observed opponent whose scaled width equals the default width, When the range is estimated, Then the start classes equal the authored default range

Given a scaled width above the default, When the range is estimated, Then it is the default plus hand-order classes not in the default, strongest first, up to the first count of combos that reaches the width (all 169 classes at 100 or more)

Given a scaled width below the default, When the range is estimated, Then it is the shortest strongest-first run of the default classes, in hand order, whose combos reach the width, and never less than the default's strongest class

Given the regenerated hand-order.json, When it loads, Then AA is first, 87s, 76s and 65s rank above K2o, Q2o and J2o, and spot-checked stored equities match seeded computeEquity against three random hands

Given the locked observed-ranges AC#2 (TASK-7.13), When the rule changes, Then it is unlocked and re-pinned under its owner to the resize rule with the edit listed in the task notes, and observed-ranges AC#5, AC#6 and observed-range-tidy AC#1 pass unchanged
Given the 4 observed golden postflop spots, When npm test runs, Then each still agrees and is clear-cut, or each changed one is re-justified with the user's sign-off

Given docs/advice/range-model.md and the hand-order justification, When the story is done, Then they describe the resize rule and the three-random-hands order and drop the matching Known limits sentence
